title.zh: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停
title.en: Character.AI申请破产：创始人回归谷歌、CEO转投迪士尼，平台面临关停

current_state.zh: Character.AI filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on October 12, with Disney submitting a $20 million initial bid covering only perpetual non-exclusive licensing of some IP rather than the platform itself, leaving the service's survival dependent on finding a buyer willing to keep operating it.
